# Several clients (C2.12): a window takes the size of the client that used it last, and the
# other client shows the part of it that fits, or the window and what is outside it;
# switch-client moves a client; detach and the end of a session give tmux's messages.
conf screen.conf
size 40x10
run new-session -d -s a 'printf "pane a\n"; exec cat'
run new-session -d -s b 'printf "pane b\n"; exec cat'
# attach-session prefers a session no client shows: one gets b (the most recent), two gets a.
client one 40x10
client two 60x14
screen one
screen two
# Without -c, switch-client moves the most recently active client: two, to b, whose window
# takes two's size as its latest client.
run switch-client -t b
screen one
screen two
# A resize makes one the latest again.
resize one 30x8
screen one
screen two
# Without -t, detach-client detaches the most recently active client: two.
run detach-client
screen two
screen one
# The end of a session ends its clients.
run kill-session -t b
screen one
run has-session -t a
